title: Discovering and Preserving Category Correlation Knowledge via Adaptive Reciprocal Knowledge Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2609.13199v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Knowledge distillation aims to improve the performance of lightweight student models by transferring knowledge from larger and more powerful teacher models. However, a substantial size gap between teacher and student models often impedes effective knowledge transfer. Most existing approaches adopt a static, one-way teacher-to-student distillation paradigm, which overlooks the dynamic nature of student learning and fails to provide targeted guidance on hard samples. In this paper, we propose adaptive reciprocal knowledge distillation (AR-KD), a novel method that improves knowledge transfer by simplifying the teacher's output distribution. Specifically, AR-KD performs reciprocal adaptation on the teacher by matching its class correlation matrix to the student's relational representation, which reshapes the teacher's prediction structure to better suit the student's capacity. translated_title: 通过自适应互惠知识蒸馏发现并保持类别相关性知识
translated_abstract: 知识蒸馏旨在通过从更大、更强大的教师模型向轻量级学生模型传递知识来提升学生模型的性能。然而，教师和学生模型之间巨大的规模差距往往会阻碍有效的知识传递。大多数现有方法采用静态的单向师生蒸馏范式，忽视了学生学习的动态特性，无法针对困难样本提供有针对性的指导。在本文中，我们提出了自适应互惠知识蒸馏（AR-KD），这是一种通过简化教师输出分布来改善知识传递的新方法。具体而言，AR-KD 通过将教师的类别相关矩阵与学生的关系表示进行匹配，对教师执行互惠自适应调整，从而重塑教师的预测结构，使其更好地适应学生的能力。这种关系对齐缓解了类间……
tldr: 提出自适应互惠知识蒸馏（AR-KD），通过将教师的类别相关矩阵与学生关系表示对齐来简化教师输出分布、自适应地重塑教师的预测结构，从而缓解师生规模差距带来的知识传递障碍，提升轻量级学生模型的性能。
en_tdlr: Proposes Adaptive Reciprocal Knowledge Distillation (AR-KD), which simplifies the teacher's output distribution by adaptively aligning its class correlation matrix with the student's relational representation, mitigating the teacher-student size gap and improving lightweight student model performance.
